messages:
Tina: Hey — our rerank calls are returning 200 but some docs are being ignored and a bunch of results have score 0. Happened after I upped docset size to ~220. No obvious error in the client. :confused:
Maria: Thanks — can you paste the curl you used and a minimal repro? Also what model/endpoint (rerank/v1)?
Tina: Using /v1/rerank, model=redwood-ranker-large. Curl below (trimmed):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "Find relevant policies for refund and returns, include edge cases", "documents": ["<doc1>", "<doc2>", "... up to 220 docs ..."] }'
```
Tina: Response body is fine (JSON with scores array) but length of scores < number of docs and some scores are 0. No 413, no 4xx.
Maria: Huh. Do you have the raw server response headers? Any X-.* headers? Also what region and account?
Tina: Headers paste: `Content-Type: application/json`, `Content-Length: 7123`, `X-Rate-Limit-Remaining: 998`, no obvious warning. Region: us-west-2. Account: acme-inc.
OpsBot: Automated notice: request payload length exceeded soft threshold for rerank. Action: partial scoring applied to keep latency SLOs. See support link: https://rwd.internal/incidents/partial-scoring
Tina: Uh — that explains *why* some docs are missing but the UX is confusing because we got 200 and no explicit field saying "truncated". Could we at least get a warning header or explicit `truncated_docs_count`? :thinking:
Kyle: Investigating — short summary: if tokens(characters) across query+docs > limit_x, runtime currently truncates trailing docs to preserve latency and returns scores for processed docs; it doesn't surface truncation in the JSON body which is a bad UX. OpsBot's internal hook logs it but not surfaced to external clients.
Maria: Can you share repro logs (request id) so we can correlate? Tina: Request-Id: rq_02b9c4f1. Sent to support already.
Kyle: Thanks — immediate suggestions/workarounds:
- Reduce docs per call (<= 100) or pre-filter heavy docs
- Trim long docs client-side (keep first 2000 chars)
- Use batching: split docset into N requests and merge scores client-side
We'll follow up with an infra fix to return a `truncated` boolean + `processed_docs` count and 413 when nothing processed.
Tina: Workaround is fine for now. Can we get ETA on the server UX change? Our customers will hit this in prod. :sos:
Kyle: Assigning a small patch for next sprint (ETA ~ 7 business days) to add `truncated_docs_count` to response and `X-Rerank-Truncated: true` header when partial scoring occurs. Also adding a best-effort 4xx when query itself is invalid.
Maria: I'll send a proactive message to ACME with the temporary workaround and ask them to limit to <=100 docs while we roll fix.
Tina: Thanks — appreciate quick triage.
Kyle: One more note for triage: attach the minimal repro with ~220 synthetic short docs to reproduce silent truncation; put it in the ticket so eng can run locally.
Maria: Noted. I'll add it. :thumbsup:
